question: Consortium roles: Which organizations participate in the ALPINE project, what role does each play (coordinator, materials, manufacturing, pilot operation), and which agency funds it?
query:
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'ALPINE'})<-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
OPTIONAL MATCH (agency:FundingAgency)-[f:FUNDS]->(p)
RETURN o.name AS organization,
       [l IN labels(o) WHERE l <> 'Organization'][0] AS org_type,
       r.role AS role,
       r.contribution AS contribution,
       agency.name AS funded_by,
       f.amount AS grant_amount,
       f.currency AS currency
ORDER BY CASE r.role WHEN 'coordinator' THEN 0 WHEN 'materials' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'manufacturing' THEN 2 WHEN 'pilot operation' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

question: Publication output: For each project, list its publications together with the authors and their affiliations.
query:
MATCH (proj:Project)<-[:RESULT_OF]-(pub:Publication)<-[a:AUTHORED]-(per:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (per)-[aff:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(org:Organization)
  WHERE aff.type IN ['employment', 'study']
    AND coalesce(aff.start_year, 0) <= pub.year
    AND coalesce(aff.end_year, 9999) >= pub.year
WITH proj, pub, a.position AS pos, per, collect(org.name) AS orgs
ORDER BY proj.name, pub.year, pub.title, pos
WITH proj, pub,
     collect(per.name + ' (' + reduce(s = '', o IN orgs | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + o) + ')') AS authors
RETURN proj.name AS project,
       pub.title AS publication,
       pub.year AS year,
       pub.venue AS venue,
       authors AS authors_with_affiliation
ORDER BY project, year, publication

question: Academic lineage: Trace the complete supervision chain for every doctoral researcher (e.g. who is the "academic grandparent" of Sofia Lindqvist and Tomas Berg?).
query:
MATCH path = (root:Person)-[:SUPERVISED*1..]->(student:Person)
WHERE NOT ()-[:SUPERVISED]->(root)
WITH student, path, nodes(path) AS chain, last(relationships(path)) AS sup
RETURN student.name AS doctoral_researcher,
       sup.status AS doctorate_status,
       sup.year AS completed_year,
       chain[-2].name AS supervisor,
       CASE WHEN size(chain) >= 3 THEN chain[-3].name END AS academic_grandparent,
       reduce(s = head(chain).name, n IN tail(chain) | s + ' -> ' + n.name) AS supervision_chain,
       length(path) AS generations_from_root
ORDER BY generations_from_root DESC, doctoral_researcher

question: Mobility: Which researchers have been affiliated with more than one organization (employment or study), and what was the direction of each move?
query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[a:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(o:Organization)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:Country)
WHERE a.type IN ['employment', 'study']
WITH p, a, o, c
ORDER BY a.current, coalesce(a.start_year, a.end_year)
WITH p, collect({org: o.name, type: a.type, position: a.position, start: a.start_year, end: a.end_year,
                 country: c.name,
                 sector: CASE WHEN o:Company THEN 'industry' WHEN o:Utility THEN 'utility' ELSE 'academia' END}) AS hist
WHERE size(hist) > 1
UNWIND range(0, size(hist) - 2) AS i
WITH p, hist[i] AS f, hist[i + 1] AS t
RETURN p.name AS researcher,
       f.org + ' (' + f.type + ', ' + f.position + ')' AS moved_from,
       t.org + ' (' + t.type + ', ' + t.position + ')' AS moved_to,
       coalesce(t.start, f.end) AS year_of_move,
       f.sector + ' -> ' + t.sector AS sector_direction,
       f.country + ' -> ' + t.country AS geographic_direction
ORDER BY year_of_move, researcher

question: Funding overview: For each funding agency, list the projects funded, amounts and currencies, and which companies and utilities take part in those projects.
query:
MATCH (agency:FundingAgency)-[f:FUNDS]->(p:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Organization)-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p)
  WHERE o:Company OR o:Utility
WITH agency, f, p, o, r ORDER BY o.name
WITH agency, f, p,
     [x IN collect(CASE WHEN o:Company THEN o.name + ' (' + r.role + ')' END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS companies,
     [x IN collect(CASE WHEN o:Utility THEN o.name + ' (' + r.role + ')' END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS utilities
RETURN agency.name AS funding_agency,
       p.name AS project,
       f.amount AS amount,
       f.currency AS currency,
       toString(f.start_year) + '-' + toString(f.end_year) AS period,
       companies,
       utilities
ORDER BY funding_agency, project

question: International reach: Rank researchers by the number of distinct countries represented among their co-authors (excluding their own).
query:
MATCH (r:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)
WITH DISTINCT r
MATCH (r)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current: true}]->(:Organization)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(home:Country)
WITH r, collect(DISTINCT home) AS homes
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(co:Person)
               -[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current: true}]->(:Organization)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:Country)
WHERE NOT c IN homes
WITH r, homes, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS foreign_countries
RETURN r.name AS researcher,
       [h IN homes | h.name] AS own_country,
       size(foreign_countries) AS distinct_foreign_coauthor_countries,
       foreign_countries
ORDER BY distinct_foreign_coauthor_countries DESC, researcher

question: Citation influence: Which publications cite the 2022 cathode stability paper, directly or indirectly (transitive citation chain)?
query:
MATCH (target:Publication {year: 2022})
WHERE toLower(target.title) CONTAINS 'cathode stability'
MATCH path = (citing:Publication)-[:CITES*1..]->(target)
WITH citing, path ORDER BY length(path)
WITH citing, collect(path)[0] AS shortest
RETURN citing.title AS citing_publication,
       citing.year AS year,
       length(shortest) AS citation_depth,
       CASE length(shortest) WHEN 1 THEN 'direct' ELSE 'indirect' END AS citation_type,
       reduce(s = head(nodes(shortest)).title, n IN tail(nodes(shortest)) | s + ' -> ' + n.title) AS citation_chain
ORDER BY citation_depth, year, citing_publication

question: Collaboration horizon: Starting from the Halvorsen Institute of Technology, which organizations are reachable within two project-collaboration hops, and through which projects?
query:
MATCH path = (start:Organization {name: 'Halvorsen Institute of Technology'})
             ((:Organization)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(:Organization)){1,2}
             (target:Organization)
WITH start, target, path, nodes(path) AS ns
WHERE target <> start
  AND all(n IN ns WHERE size([m IN ns WHERE m = n]) = 1)
WITH target, length(path) / 2 AS hops,
     reduce(s = head(ns).name, n IN tail(ns) |
            s + CASE WHEN n:Project THEN ' -[' + n.name + ']-> ' ELSE n.name END) AS route
WITH target, min(hops) AS min_hops, collect({hops: hops, route: route}) AS routes
RETURN target.name AS organization,
       min_hops AS hops,
       [r IN routes WHERE r.hops = min_hops | r.route] AS via
ORDER BY hops, organization

question: Intellectual property to field: Which sites use technology covered by a patent held by Lumen Storage Systems, and which projects, operators and inventors are connected to them?
query:
MATCH (lumen:Organization {name: 'Lumen Storage Systems'})-[:HOLDS]->(pat:Patent)
      -[:COVERS]->(tech:Technology)<-[:USES_TECHNOLOGY]-(site:Site)
RETURN site.name AS site,
       pat.id + ' - ' + pat.title AS patent,
       tech.name AS technology,
       EXISTS { (site)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(pat) } AS built_to_patent_design,
       COLLECT { MATCH (proj:Project)-[:ESTABLISHED]->(site) RETURN proj.name } AS site_projects,
       COLLECT { MATCH (pat)-[:LICENSED_IN]->(lp:Project) RETURN lp.name } AS patent_licensed_in,
       COLLECT { MATCH (op:Organization)-[:OPERATES]->(site) RETURN op.name ORDER BY op.name } AS operators,
       COLLECT { MATCH (m:Person)-[:MANAGES]->(site) RETURN m.name } AS site_managers,
       COLLECT { MATCH (sup:Organization)-[:SUPPLIED_CELLS_TO]->(site) RETURN sup.name } AS cell_supplier,
       COLLECT { MATCH (inv:Person)-[:INVENTED]->(pat) RETURN inv.name ORDER BY inv.name } AS inventors
ORDER BY site

question: Collaborator recommendation: Suggest pairs of researchers who have never co-authored but share at least one common co-author, and whose work relates to the same technology area.
query:
MATCH (a:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(common:Person)
      -[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b:Person)
WHERE a.name < b.name
  AND NOT EXISTS { (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b) }
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT common.name) AS common_coauthors
MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Technology)<-[:ABOUT]-(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b)
WITH a, b, common_coauthors, collect(DISTINCT t.name) AS shared_technology
RETURN a.name AS researcher_1,
       b.name AS researcher_2,
       common_coauthors,
       shared_technology,
       size(common_coauthors) + size(shared_technology) AS score
ORDER BY score DESC, researcher_1, researcher_2
